title: One Application manifest. The backing changes — not your app.

cards.title: Single VDS
cards.desc: A single VDS with sane simplifications (no HA quorum, single-node database, no multi-tenancy). For side-projects and solo founders. Hetzner Cloud at launch.

cards.title: Production cluster
cards.desc: Production. 3 or more nodes of any size and any count — grows with your project. Designed and in progress; ships in Phase 3 (Hetzner Cloud).

cards.title: Bare metal
cards.desc: Bare metal. Dedicated EPYC servers. For when you need a performance ceiling above VPS.

cards.title: Hyperscalers
cards.desc: Hyperscalers. Primarily for cases where regulation requires these specific providers.

orthogonalNoteHtml: Confidential containers — orthogonal capability, not a tier. Available on any hardware that supports TDX or SEV-SNP. Shipping Phase 6+.
